sections.Profile:
The Time Machine pinball machine, released by Zaccaria in 1983, features an innovative time travel theme. Notably, it includes four flippers and a section of the playfield that raises and lowers when the ball enters the "time hole," creating dynamic gameplay.

- Manufacturer: Zaccaria
- Years made: 1983
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Time Travel, Original Theme, Solid State, Colorful, Adventure, Fantasy, 1980s
